policy: Dossier for fixtures the strict ladder leaves blank. It proposes nothing that is applied automatically, records which providers were checked, and publishes the provider error text when a source refuses access. No probability, pick or alias is written by this script.
excluded_inputs: any price read from a page this script fetched (reachability only)
headline: No fixture in this snapshot is blank: every live row carries a sourced line.

limitations: A lead is a listing that mentions the same words; only the production join decides whether it is the fixture.
geo-blocked and 403 responses prove nothing about whether a market exists for a given series.
The probe runs once per pipeline refresh, so a lead can expire before it is reviewed.
